title: The Company Retreat at Pine Lodge
teaser: The startup came out to a country lodge to celebrate selling the company. At dinner founder Artyom Belov stood up with his glass and said he'd changed his mind and wouldn't sign anything on Monday. That was the end of the party, and in the night Belov was found dead in the bathhouse by the lake: its door had been jammed shut from outside with a shovel. The rain has washed away the bridge over the river, so nobody is leaving the lodge until morning.
professions: Co-founder who left a year ago

habits.label: Badge on a lanyard
habits.habit: Never takes off their company badge, even on a retreat
clues: A plastic lanyard clip lies in the mud at the bathhouse door. The culprit never takes off their company badge.
A blue fibre from the branded lanyards the badges hang on is stuck to the conference room door handle. The culprit never takes off their company badge.

habits.label: Laptop under the arm
clues: The wet bench in the changing room has a dry rectangle on it, as if a laptop had been standing there. The culprit carries a laptop everywhere.
At 01:20 the watchman saw someone walking down the dark path to the jetty, their face lit by the screen of an open laptop. The culprit carries a laptop everywhere.

habits.label: Smells of barbecue
clues: The bathhouse smells of birch twigs and steam, but right by the door there's a smell of barbecue smoke. The culprit smells of barbecue.
A smell of barbecue smoke runs along the guest building corridor to the stairs, though the grill went out long ago. The culprit smells of barbecue.

habits.label: Earbud
habits.habit: Always has one wireless earbud in
clues: A single white wireless earbud with no partner lies on the boards by the bathhouse. The culprit always has an earbud in.
At 01:15 the speaker in the karaoke cabin connected to someone's earbud on its own and beeped through the whole room. The culprit always has an earbud in.

habits.label: Thick beard
habits.habit: A thick beard they keep tugging at
clues: A wiry reddish hair, like a beard hair, is caught on the handle of the shovel that jammed the bathhouse door. The culprit has a thick beard.
A towel in the dining hall has a few short, wiry beard hairs on it. The culprit has a thick beard.

habits.label: Backwards cap
clues: The car park camera caught someone in a cap worn backwards. The culprit wears their cap backwards.
A plastic strap buckle from a baseball cap hangs on a hook in the changing room. The culprit wears their cap backwards.

habits.label: Reusable cup
habits.habit: Never without their reusable coffee cup
clues: The jetty rail has a round coffee ring from the bottom of a reusable cup. The culprit carries a reusable cup.
A silicone lid from a reusable cup, smelling of coffee, lies in the grass by the bathhouse. The culprit carries a reusable cup.

habits.label: Sauna hat
clues: There are felt pills on the bench in the steam room, and Belov's own hat hangs bone-dry on its hook. The culprit wears a felt sauna hat.
Someone's felt sauna hat, soaked through, is drying on a radiator in the guest building, and its owner won't own up. The culprit wears a felt sauna hat.

habits.label: Wet hair
clues: Lake water with duckweed has pooled under the bathhouse door, as if someone came straight up from the lake. The culprit has wet hair.
One pillow in the guest building has a wet patch that smells of the lake, though everyone says they were asleep. The culprit has wet hair.

habits.label: Wellies
clues: Deep prints of rubber boots with a big herringbone sole run from the guest building to the bathhouse. The culprit wears wellies.
The lodge's boots stand at the dining hall entrance, and one pair has fresh lake clay on it. The culprit wears wellies.

habits.label: Mosquito bites
habits.habit: Arms covered in scratched mosquito bites
clues: There's a drop of blood on the bathhouse door handle, like from a scratched mosquito bite. The culprit is covered in mosquito bites.
A tube of bite cream squeezed completely empty lies in a bin in the guest building. The culprit is covered in mosquito bites.

habits.label: Braces
clues: A plastic cup by the bathhouse has tooth marks with neat square dents, like from braces. The culprit wears braces.
A tiny elastic band from braces lies on a napkin in the dining hall. The culprit wears braces.

habits.label: Menthol cigarettes
habits.habit: Smokes cigarettes with a menthol capsule
clues: A cigarette end with a crushed menthol capsule in the filter lies by the bathhouse wall. The culprit smokes menthol cigarettes.
There's ash by the wheel of someone else's car in the car park, and it smells of menthol. The culprit smokes menthol cigarettes.

habits.label: Says "to be fair"
habits.habit: Says "to be fair" and "let's jump on a call" every other sentence
clues: The cook heard someone on the path to the bathhouse say: "To be fair, he brought it on himself." The culprit says "to be fair" every other sentence.
Someone's song sheet in the karaoke cabin has a scribble: "To be fair, it's sorted." The culprit says "to be fair" every other sentence.

habits.label: Pollen allergy
habits.habit: Sneezes at pollen and carries tissues
clues: A crumpled tissue lies in the wet grass by the bathhouse, and Belov had no allergies. The culprit sneezes at pollen.
At 01:25 the bathhouse attendant heard three loud sneezes in a row from the jetty. The culprit sneezes at pollen.

habits.label: Character on the neck
habits.habit: A Chinese character tattooed on the neck
clues: Before he died, Belov managed to trace a wonky sign like a Chinese character on the misted bathhouse window. The culprit has a character tattooed on their neck.
In an old team photo in the conference room, one person's neck has been scribbled over with marker, right where some dark sign shows. The culprit has a character tattooed on their neck.

tech: At 01:10 the lodge cameras went off: someone logged into the router settings with the factory password. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
Belov's email to the investors never went out because someone remotely turned off the internet on his phone. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
safe: The safe in the admin cabin holding the signed agreement was opened, and the last page of the agreement was swapped. The culprit knows the safe combination.
Belov's laptop in the conference room was unlocked with the password, not a fingerprint. The culprit knows the safe combination.
cash: An hour after Belov died, a ticket for a morning flight to Yerevan was bought on the company card. The culprit had access to money.
The lodge till in the dining hall is shut, but someone refunded the banquet deposit to another person's card. The culprit had access to money.
quiet: There's gravel under the guest building windows, and any step can be heard on the whole floor, yet nobody heard a thing. The culprit moves silently.
The bathhouse attendant was dozing in the changing room and didn't wake when someone walked past him to the steam room door. The culprit moves silently.
sched: Belov always steamed alone at exactly one in the morning and told everyone so at every company party. The culprit knows the schedule.
At 01:20 the watchman walks round the car park, and he doesn't get to the bathhouse until two. The culprit knows the schedule.
keys: The equipment shed the shovel came from was locked, and nobody broke the lock. The culprit had keys.
Belov's room in the guest building was opened with a key card at 01:40, when Belov was already dead. The culprit had keys.
tools: The bathhouse door latch was bent so the door can't be opened from inside, without it showing from outside. The culprit is handy with tools.
The door closer was taken off the conference room door and put back without stripping a single screw. The culprit is handy with tools.
french: "Tout est vendu", French for "Everything's sold", is written over the strategy chart on the flipchart in the conference room. The culprit knows French.
An email was deleted from Belov's inbox, and the reply to it was in French: "Il ne signera pas", meaning "He won't sign". The culprit knows French.
driver: The investor's car was driven from the car park to the jetty and back, leaving tyre tracks in the wet grass. The culprit can drive.
The lodge's quad bike, which always has its key in the ignition, was driven up to the bathhouse, and its engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
passages: A staff path runs behind the fence from the dining hall kitchen to the bathhouse. Only the staff use it, and there are fresh footprints on it. The culprit knows the service passages.
A fire escape runs down from the guest building to the lake, and the window onto it was opened from inside. The culprit knows the service passages.
strong: The shovel that jammed the bathhouse door was driven so deep into the ground that it took three people to pull it out. The culprit is physically strong.
A water barrel weighing over a hundred kilos was pushed up against the steam room window. The culprit is physically strong.
medic: The water bottle in the changing room has blood-pressure pills dissolved in it, and Belov couldn't take them in even a small dose. The culprit knows about poisons.
A blister pack of heart pills is missing from the kitchen first-aid kit, and the empty box was put back. The culprit knows about poisons.
